summary: Design AI reskilling pathways, assess skills gaps and measure programme value. Explore the five-day course for HR and L&D leaders.
lede: AI reskilling strategy training helps senior HR and learning leaders plan workforce capability as AI changes tasks and roles. It covers assessing skills gaps, mapping role and task changes, designing learning pathways with 70:20:10 and ADDIE, and planning for employee impact and human oversight. Participants also explore measuring learning transfer and programme value, and develop practical assessments, pathway maps, change plans and workforce roadmaps.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for senior HR and learning leaders responsible for workforce capability as AI changes roles, skills demand, and operating models.
outcomes: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
modules: AI Role Redesign and Task Analysis
prerequisites: You should have practical responsibility for HR, talent, organisational development, or learning and development. Familiarity with your organisation’s AI adoption priorities and workforce planning approach will help you apply the exercises. No coding or programming is required.
